facts.fact: The EBRD board report says the Tunisian Government 'has launched' the National Digital Strategy 2021-2025; no adopting act or body beyond 'the Government' is named, and the launch date is not given, so the date is the report's (2024-07-24).

The report gives the National Digital Strategy 2021-2025 a stated period of 2021-2025, which includes the report's date of 2024-07-24; it neither links nor quotes the text from an official site. Text public: not stated

systems.tiers: key objectives include infrastructure development (telecoms, broadband, mobile, fibre, rural areas); the held passage lists no other pillar

note: Class left empty: the held passage describes only the strategy's infrastructure objective, not whether it covers both economy and state.
